 Follow ‘Dancing With the Stars’ Season 35 Winner Odds Revealed Ahead of Week 6: All 10 Remaining Stars Ranked
 Bradley Stern Updated Tue, October 20, 2026 at 2:01 PM UTC 4 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. ABC Dancing With the Stars Season 35 is back tonight, and the latest predictions reveal which celebrities are favored to win!
 The ABC dancing competition returns on Tuesday (October 20) for "Dedication Night," following last week's "Super Bowl Night," which saw Guillermo Rodriguez and his partner Witney Carson eliminated.
 With 10 celebrities remaining, traders on prediction market Kalshi are continuing to predict who will take home the Len Goodman Mirrorball Trophy.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement One celebrity remains the clear favorite with a 54% chance of winning, far ahead of the rest of the competition. Meanwhile, several other stars have shifted positions since last week's rankings.
 The predictions could change again following tonight's performances and results!
 NOTE: These percentages are based on Kalshi prediction market prices as of October 20 and are subject to change. They reflect market trading, not official results or guaranteed outcomes. 
 Click through to see which remaining Dancing With the Stars Season 35 contestants are currently favored to win, ranked from lowest to highest odds… 
 (TIE) 9. Tatyana Ali – Less than 1% chance of winning 
 Tatyana Ali currently has less than a 1% chance of winning Season 35.
 Advertisement Advertisement The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air actress is competing with pro Jan Ravnik .
 (TIE) 9. Tyler Cameron – Less than 1% chance of winning 
 Tyler Cameron currently has less than a 1% chance of winning Season 35.
 The Bachelorette alum is competing with pro Sharna Burgess .
 (TIE) 7. Jackson Olson – 3% chance of winning 
 Jackson Olson currently has a 3% chance of winning Season 35.
 The Savannah Bananas star is competing with pro Emma Slater .
 Jackson entered the competition with an 8% chance of winning, according to the prediction market.
 (TIE) 7. Connor Wood – 3% chance of winning 
 Comedian and content creator Connor Wood currently has a 3% chance of winning Season 35.
 He is competing with pro Rylee Arnold .
 Connor entered the season with a 4% chance of winning, according to the prediction market.
 Advertisement Advertisement 6. Julia Stiles – 4% chance of winning 
 Actress Julia Stiles is currently given a 4% chance of winning Season 35.
 The Save the Last Dance star is competing with pro Ezra Sosa .
 Julia was initially one of the favorites on the prediction market, with a 15% chance of winning ahead of the premiere, but her odds have fallen considerably since the competition began.
 5. Jenna Dewan – 6% chance of winning 
 Jenna Dewan currently has a 6% chance of winning Season 35.
 Jenna is partnered with pro Val Chmerkovskiy , though Alan Bersten will temporarily step in for him during tonight's episode following Val 's one-week suspension.
 Jenna was actually the prediction market's favorite to win before the season began, with a 23% chance of taking home the Mirrorball Trophy. She has since fallen considerably in the ranking.
 4. Harry Shum Jr. – 10% chance of winning 
 Harry Shum Jr. currently has a 10% chance of winning Season 35.
 Advertisement Advertisement The Glee and Grey's Anatomy actor is competing with pro Jenna Johnson .
 Harry was the second favorite ahead of the premiere with a 20% chance of winning, but his odds have since dropped.
 3. Maura Higgins – 11% chance of winning 
 Maura Higgins currently has an 11% chance of winning Season 35.
 The Love Island and The Traitors star is competing with returning pro and Traitors co-star Mark Ballas .
 Maura has experienced one of the biggest gains since the season began. She had just a 3% chance of winning ahead of the premiere and has now climbed to third place in the prediction market.
 2. Amber Glenn – 12% chance of winning 
 Olympic figure skater Amber Glenn currently has a 12% chance of winning Season 35.
 Advertisement Advertisement She is competing with pro Pasha Pashkov .
 Amber entered the competition as one of the early favorites with a 17% chance of winning and remains near the top of the prediction market.
 1. Ezra Frech – 54% chance of winning – CURRENT FAVORITE 
 Ezra Frech has emerged as the clear prediction market favorite, with a 54% chance of winning Season 35.
 The Paralympic gold medalist is competing with pro Daniella Karagach .
 That's a huge jump from before the premiere, when Ezra had a 13% chance of winning and ranked fifth. His market-implied chance of winning has now more than quadrupled , putting him well ahead of the other contestants.
